ValidationRule.description: When Case = Sales Offers Request, Incremental is mandatory except for Type = Survey, Adhoc
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ NOT ( $User.UserRoleId = $Label.QF_Support_QIC_Member), /*QF-Support-Agency Support-QAC*/ ISBLANK ( Incremental_Revenue__c ), NOT ( ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Survey")), NOT ( ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Adhoc")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Sales Offers, you will need to populated the Incremental Revenue ($) field
